about: Study Desk audition A1 (2026-10-21): button and moment effects in three material families, plus one calm theme per surface. Generated by tools/audio/desk-audition.mjs; triaged in index.html. Nothing here is wired into the desk.

families.wood: soft wooden marimba and felt mallet, warm, dry room
families.glass: small glass bell and celesta, airy, light reverb
families.felt: felt piano and soft analog synth pad, round, intimate

cues.label: D-pad focus move
cues.brief: a single, very soft and short tick for moving focus between buttons; heard dozens of times a minute, so barely there, no tail

cues.label: Select / OK
cues.brief: a short, gentle confirming tap for pressing a button; slightly brighter than a focus tick, quick decay

cues.label: Back
cues.brief: a short, soft downward two-note tap for going back; lower and calmer than the confirm

cues.label: Phone joined
cues.brief: a friendly rising three-note welcome when a phone connects to the TV; warm, unhurried

cues.label: Hint arrives / new card
cues.brief: a soft, curious single shimmer as a new card appears; neutral, implies neither right nor wrong

cues.label: Verdict: right
cues.brief: a gentle, satisfied rising two-note chime for a correct answer; modest, not a fanfare

cues.label: Verdict: try again
cues.brief: an encouraging, soft neutral two-note figure for 'try again'; never a buzzer, no sadness, no dissonance

cues.label: Break
cues.brief: a relaxed, slow descending arpeggio that says it is time for a break; calm, breathing space

tracks.label: Desk home
tracks.prompt: Calm, warm instrumental loop for the home screen of a family homework app on a living-room TV. Felt piano, soft upright bass, brushed light percussion, 80 BPM, major key, gentle and welcoming. Seamless loop, no build-up, no vocals, no sudden changes.

tracks.label: Linga English
tracks.prompt: Light, friendly instrumental loop for a children's English conversation app. Nylon-string guitar, soft marimba, light shaker, 90 BPM, sunny and curious, like a cafe in the morning. Seamless loop, no vocals, low dynamics, nothing that competes with a speaking voice.

tracks.label: Math Buddy
tracks.prompt: Focused, calm instrumental loop for a maths practice app. Soft plucked synth arpeggio, warm pad, sparse glassy bells, 72 BPM, steady and patient, clear and uncluttered. Seamless loop, no vocals, no drums, no tension.

tracks.label: Essay Master
tracks.prompt: Reflective, quiet instrumental loop for a writing app. Solo felt piano with a distant string pad, 66 BPM, thoughtful and spacious, like a library at dusk. Seamless loop, no vocals, no percussion, very low dynamics.

tracks.label: Break
tracks.prompt: Relaxing instrumental loop for a short study break. Soft Rhodes electric piano, gentle vinyl warmth, mellow lo-fi brushed beat, 70 BPM, cosy and unhurried. Seamless loop, no vocals, no sudden changes.
